videos.name: Mr. Robot_dec0d3d.doc
videos.overview: A look at the authenticity and and societal impact of Mr. Robot. Creator Sam Esmail, stars Rami Malek and Christian Slater, real-life hacker Jeff Moss and several other experts open up about how the show made an extremely technical subject relatable to a wide audience and brought humanity to hackers through main character Elliot.
